uploads/science/Scipad/Year 9 Book 1/Ans.searchText: MATTER What is Matter? Scientists define matter as anything that has mass and occupies space. The space they are referring to is not outer space where astronauts go, but space that takes up volume. For example, water is matter because it has a mass (we can use scales to prove this) and it takes up volume in a container (which we can measure using a measuring cylinder). Scientists use the word particle to describe matter that is too small to see.
